summary: * Wave 17 regression pins for the three confirmed control/wiring defects. * Each test fails on the pre-fix tree and passes on the repaired tree.
* build-repo-map.ts * Lightweight symbol/import map for a generated run (no tree-sitter, no network). * Exit 0 pass, 2 usage, 3 not found, 9 internal.
* context-pack-report.ts * Summarize persisted context packs for a run. Read-only. * Exit 0 pass, 2 usage, 3 not found, 9 internal.
* eval-router.ts * Offline summary of deterministic route decisions. Read-only; no provider calls. * Exit 0 pass, 6 insufficient data, 9 internal.
* integrity-check.ts * Recompute artifact hashes and compare against the stored manifest/registry. * Exit 0 pass, 2 usage, 3 not found, 5 mismatch, 9 internal.
* Preflight gate. Read-only: it never opens a key, a DB, or the network. * Exit codes: 0 pass, 2 usage, 7 resource/browser/port refusal, 9 internal.
* replay-run.ts * Reconstruct a run from persisted events and artifacts. Never calls the LLM. * Exit 0 pass, 2 usage, 3 not found, 4 integrity failure, 9 internal.
* screenshot.mjs â€” evidence-only UI capture. Not part of the product runtime.

Fixed boundary; buildSystemPrompt is idempotent around this token.
Insert one durable projection event inside an existing transaction.
* One real provider call for a durable chat job. Budget reservations are scoped * to the cycle ledger and settled on every HTTP attempt; a failed provider call * never leaves a reservation held.
Events are replayed newest-window-first only when the cursor exceeds the window.
Start the one in-process worker. Startup reaps expired leases first.
Maximum successful output length in characters. Default 32,000.
Optional failed-patch commit. Must already exist in the run workspace.

* The only P7 primary metric. Gate pass is deterministic: * all mandatory checks pass, no critical safety finding, every planned file exists, * and syntax explicitly passed. No LLM judge, no inference from prose.

* The UI must not treat an incomplete block, a revoked consent, or an * unrelated consent scope as readiness. This is derived from the same * complete-block/active-consent rules the evaluation services enforce.
Two-sided exact McNemar p-value on the discordant counts.
Backwards-compatible name used by the first scaffold.
* Filename: src/server/llm/index.ts * Dependencies: ./client.js * Run: imported by server modules
* Commit a reservation. `actualMicroUsd === null` means the provider did not * report usage: hold the reserved amount and mark it unknown, not zero.
* Compute one gate decision. Input is parsed by Zod at the boundary; every * branch is deterministic and total for valid inputs.
Lexical only: no filesystem access, no symlink check.
A same-value transition is the idempotent no-op; terminal states may not move elsewhere.
Append one redacted structured error record to the durable error log.
Approximate changed-node count by comparing leaf/leaf-token nodes in AST order.
* Preserve what the user paid for when a run does not publish. These rows are * explicitly `staged`, live under workspace/staged, and are never presented as * accepted artifacts.
* RVS module alias. * * The algorithm is implemented in ./rvs.ts; this file keeps the conventional * verify/scheduler import name available without creating a second behavior.
* The effective per-run budget in USD. Routing must use this, not the global * MAX_RUN_COST_USD, or it can allocate a plan the run cannot afford before the * first provider call.
Undo a published tree after a post-publish DB/vault failure.
Number of this run's events after the cursor (the run's own rows, not the global seq space).
Binary/text routes are not JSON; they still get a typed response schema.

* Minimal environment for the Python AST checker. Never forward provider * credentials (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, AWS/GitHub tokens) or * arbitrary PYTHONPATH injection into a child process.
Convert a capability path glob to a deterministic workspace-relative matcher.
* Shared live-chat contracts. The server is the source of truth for every * projection; the web client consumes these shapes and never computes run/job * state locally.
Exact substring copied from the user prompt; required for source=user.
Every name the client registers a listener for.
Every input file the reviewer declares it inspected. Missing coverage is named by the gate.
* Schema fixtures for the agent registry. Kept separate from the tests so the * same valid/invalid cases can be reused by future adapter tests.
Simulate a terminal row written before the terminal-usage fix: terminal, spend still NULL.
